description: This file provides utility functions and classes for testing and manipulating internal representations of string data structures in the Abseil library, including creating substrings, flats, external nodes, converting reps to strings, and managing reference counts.

classes.name: AutoUnref
classes.description: RAII helper class that automatically unreferences stored string reps upon destruction.

methods.name: MakeSubstring
methods.description: Creates a substring representation of a given string rep starting at a specific index with a specified length.

methods.name: MakeFlat
methods.description: Creates a flat string representation from a string view.

methods.name: MakeExternal
methods.description: Creates an external string node for testing purposes.

methods.name: CreateRandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length from a set of characters.

methods.name: CreateFlatsFromString
methods.description: Splits a string into multiple flat string representations of a specified chunk size.

methods.name: CordRepBtreeFromFlats
methods.description: Builds a B-tree representation from a list of flat string reps.

methods.name: CordVisitReps
methods.description: Traverses a string representation tree, applying a function to each node.

methods.name: CordCollectRepsIf
methods.description: Collects reps satisfying a predicate from a string representation tree.

methods.name: CordCollectReps
methods.description: Collects all reps from a string representation tree.

methods.name: CordToString
methods.description: Converts a string representation tree into a concatenated string.

methods.name: AutoUnref
methods.description: Helper class that automatically unreferences string reps when destroyed.
